credit_line: Whitney Museum of American Art, New York; gift of Calvin Klein
description: A beige deer skull with curling antlers rests at the center of the composition against a white background. A red paintbrush flower, along with a few small yellow flowers, floats underneath the skull, just above the landscape that fills the bottom quarter of the canvas. In the landscape, rolling brown hills stretch out beneath a clouded blue and white sky.
